verdict.rationale: Manufact documents an inspector that runs alongside a local MCP server, and a dashboard that connects to a pasted MCP URL for Chat and testing without deploying. Together these suggest you can exercise a server before integrating it, but the evidence never says the inspector is browser-based or describes invoking individual tools interactively. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a browser-based inspector or playground UI, description of invoking individual tools with custom inputs and viewing results, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can exercise an MCP server's tools from a browser-based inspector or playground before integrating it

citations.quote: Run your MCP server locally with hot reload + inspector
paste your MCP URL. No deploy required: Manufact connects directly for Chat, testing, and the publish workflow.
Manufact executes them across different MCP clients and LLM models
